CustomField.description: Payment block of the monthly receipt: Cash = top-level Cash (default, D28); CreditCardLines = CustomFields, one credit card line per charge; DealNumbers = DealNumbers[]. Blank = Receipt_Link_Deal_Numbers__c decides (true = DealNumbers, false = Cash). Turn on CreditCardLines only after a manual test on terminal 1001 and Cardcom's approval for the production terminal (Q15).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Cash = מזומן (ברירת מחדל); CreditCardLines = שורת אשראי לכל חיוב; DealNumbers = קישור מספרי עסקאות. ריק = לפי Receipt Link Deal Numbers.
CustomField.label: Receipt Payment Mode
